info.name: Update the specified work activity of a work order

params.name: workorderId
params.description: The unique numeric identifier of the work order for which you want to update a work activity.

params.name: workactivityId
params.description: The unique numeric identifier of the work activity to update.

items.docs:
Updates the specified work activity of a work order by setting the check-in and check-out date and time values passed in the request.

info.name: Create a work activity for the specified work order

params.name: workorderId
params.description: The unique numeric identifier of the work order for which you want to create a work activity.

items.docs:
Creates a new work activity for the specified work order. The work activity type can be either *Travel* or *Repair*. Note that custom types may be configured for a subscriber.

info.name: Delete the specified work activities of a work order

params.name: workorderId
params.description: The unique numeric identifier of the work order for which you want to delete work activities.

params.name: workactivityIds
params.description: The unique numeric identifiers of the work activities to delete.

items.docs:
Delete one or more work activities of the specified work order. When you pass multiple work activity IDs, the request will succeed if at least one ID is valid.
***Note:*** Both subscribers and providers can use this method.

items.docs:
Returns work activities of the specified work order.
A work activity details information about the technician's work on a service request: the time when the technician started and finished their work, the type of activity they carried out, the number of technicians who rendered the service, and other details related to the labor performed.
***Note:*** Both subscribers and providers can use this method.
